title: Members
hint: Review the permissions of active members in this collection.
empty: There are no active members to manage.
ownerOnlyHint: Only the collection owner can manage this member list, even when another member has administrative permissions.
revokeHint: Remove all collection permissions for {member}. Current: {before}. This does not remove the membership or delete ratings.
unknown: Could not confirm the change. Check the current permissions before trying again.
invalid: These permissions could not be saved. Review the current list.
loadError: Could not load the member list.
busy: Wait for the member permissions update before leaving.
discardHint: Your changes to member permissions will not be saved.
